report.title: Report
report.subtitle: Tell us what's wrong.
report.guide: Only our moderators can see your report. We review every report and act on it. The person you report will not be told who reported them.
report.detailPlaceholder: The more specific you are, the faster we can review it.

reasonHint.hate: Attacks or slurs aimed at a person or group
reasonHint.impersonation: Pretending to be another person or organization
reasonHint.privacy: Contact details, address, or identity shared without consent
reasonHint.copyright: Work posted without the rights holder's permission
reasonHint.other: A problem none of the reasons above cover

result.success: Report submitted. We'll review it and take action.
result.alreadyReported: You've already reported this. Your report is under review.
result.selfTarget: You can't report your own content.
result.loginRequired: Sign in to submit a report.
result.reasonMissing: Choose a reason for your report.
result.detailMissing: Please add details when you choose "Something else".
result.detailTooLong: Details can be up to {max} characters.
result.error: We couldn't submit your report. Please try again in a moment.

block.confirmMessage: Once blocked, this user's posts and activity will no longer appear for you. You can unblock them at any time.
block.confirmNote: They won't be told that you blocked them.
block.unblockConfirmMessage: Their posts and activity will appear for you again.

result.error: We couldn't update the block. Please try again in a moment.

blockedList.title: Blocked users
blockedList.description: Posts and activity from blocked users never appear for you.
blockedList.emptyGuide: If someone bothers you, block them from their profile or from the post menu.
blockedList.loadError: We couldn't load your blocked users.

myReports.title: My reports
myReports.description: See the reports you've submitted and how they were handled.

ugcNotice.title: Before you post
ugcNotice.body: By posting, you agree to the Terms of Service and the prohibited content standards. Abusive language, discriminatory remarks, advertising, exposure of personal information, and copyright infringement may be reported and removed by our team.
ugcNotice.compact: Posting means you agree to the Terms of Service and content standards.
